scripts.desktop:fixture: npm run data:fixture && node --import tsx desktop/fixtures/generate.mts
scripts.desktop:fixture:check: npm run data:fixture:check && node --import tsx desktop/fixtures/generate.mts --check
scripts.dev:demo: npm run data:fixture && npm run dev --workspace web -- --mode demo --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace pipeline && npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm run typecheck:eval --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace pipeline && npm run test:unit --workspace web && node --test web/bench/performance-budget-rules.test.mjs
scripts.bench:browser:fixture: npm run data:fixture && npm run data:fixture:check && npm run build --workspace web -- --mode demo && node web/bench/browser-performance.mjs
scripts.bench:browser:scale: npm run data:fixture && npm run data:fixture:check && npm run build --workspace web -- --mode demo && node --import tsx web/bench/generate-performance-scenario.ts && node web/bench/browser-performance.mjs --scenario=scale
scripts.eval:user-vector:fixture: npm run data:fixture:check && npm run eval:user-vector:fixture --workspace web
scripts.eval:new-user:fixture: npm run new-user:split:fixture:check && npm run eval:new-user:fixture --workspace web
scripts.eval:hybrid:split:select: npm run new-user:split:fixture:check && node --import tsx web/bench/split-first-hybrid-selection.ts select
scripts.eval:experiments:fixture: npm run new-user:split:fixture:check && node --import tsx web/bench/split-first-experiment-eval.ts
scripts.eval:metrics:fixture: npm run new-user:split:fixture:check && node --import tsx web/bench/split-first-metric-report.ts
scripts.eval:hybrid-blend:fixture: npm run data:fixture:check && npm run eval:hybrid-blend:fixture --workspace web
scripts.eval:franchise-diversity:fixture: npm run data:fixture:check && npm run eval:franchise-diversity:fixture --workspace web
scripts.build: npm run build:graph --workspace pipeline -- && npm run sync:web && npm run build --workspace web
